What guests come for

From what guests write on Google and what the café lists on Instagram.

A coffee blend that is not bitter

Guests write that the coffee is made with Arabica and that the blend is not as bitter as in many other places.

Fresh juice and smoothies

Freshly squeezed orange juice comes up again and again in the reviews. Smoothies and matcha are on offer too.

Breakfast and snacks

Breakfast, toasted sandwiches, croissants, traditional pies and Cypriot pastries.

Free delivery

The café offers free delivery on 96 120444. Takeaway comes in a bag with a cup holder.

A café in the old town

Urban Coffee Co is at Agiou Kendeou 37, in the pedestrian centre of the Paphos old town, under a dark sign with the gold U. Inside there are mint walls, patterned floor tiles and a long wooden bench with round cushions. Outside, tables stand under sunshades next to the plants. Guests mention the view of two classic early 20th century buildings.

What guests say

Three of 91 Google reviews, 73 of them with five stars.

“Excellent little coffee shop. Lovely coffee blend (not too bitter like man other places). They had some nice Cypriot pastries that we were recommended. The two men working there were very friendly and engaging. Good area of outdoor seating for some people watching!”

Google review
“I love them! They use Arabica while almost all of the coffee places and cafes are using overroasted robusta. So to me local coffee usually tastes bitter. Except for this place! Location is great too.”

Google review
“Our daily coffee place in Old town. Friendly staff, relax atmosphere and nice coffee blend.”
